description: Per-mode news relevance profiles (NIC-127). Each mode config's `newsProfile` maps here to one or more NewsData.io categories (comma-separated), selecting the headlines the bottom-left News panel surfaces for that mode. Source configuration lives here, not hardcoded in the adapter (FR-CFG). An unmapped profile falls back to `defaultCategory`. `feeds` lists the free RSS/Atom sources the panel falls back to when the metered provider is rate-limited, unreachable, or has no API key configured; an unmapped profile falls back to `defaultFeeds`, and no feeds at all simply means the fallback cannot serve that profile. `interestQuery` controls whether the user's News Interests note (NIC-223) is also sent to the metered provider as a `q=` keyword search: `q` sends it, `off` suppresses it and leaves ranking to the client side. Verified against the live free tier: `q` combines with `category` and `prioritydomain`, and the endpoint caps a query at 100 characters (not the 512 the vendor's blog claims) — a longer query is rejected with 422. Each feed's `source` is the publisher name shown on the headline row — set it, because feed titles are marketing copy ('www.espn.com - TOP'), not labels.
